title: BD-SHS: A Benchmark Dataset for Learning to Detect Online Bangla Hate Speech in Different Social Contexts
reasoning: The paper's core task is the detection of hate speech, which is an ethical concern. It specifically includes 'Religion' as a key category in its hierarchical annotation scheme for hate speech types. The dataset is designed to identify and categorize comments targeting individuals or groups based on their religious beliefs, making the evaluation of religion-based hate speech a central component of the work.
